arStrings.szText: The Watchman
Return to the First Vault in Skartara and find the Sigil of Iben Fahd
Return to the First Vault in Skartara and find the Sigil of Iben Fahd
The old Vault on Skartara is the only place we might reforge the Blade. If we find the Cube, perhaps we can stand a chance against Mephisto.
By stepping into the Vault with demon blood in my veins, I have sprung a trap left by the old Horadrim. The way is blocked until we find all four Sigils: keys to a runic lock. Iben Fahd is next.
